data.narrative:
Beyond Reach Labs is a pre-seed stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Mitchell Fogelson and Pele Collins. The target has raised $500K to date with $175M+ in letters of intent. The valuation universe comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Of three triangulation methods examined, only stage-progression proved applicable. This method uses the company's $500K total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for pre-seed to next-stage progression, yielding a $1.25M implied valuation. The peer-median approach could not be deployed due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the Space & Aerospace sector (zero datapoints met filtering thresholds; 11 same-sector peers exist but lack sufficient narrowing). Public-comp anchoring using the sector's 23.9x median P/S multiple across 6 tickers is inapplicable without disclosed target revenue, which private companies rarely report.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.06M–$1.44M, centered on $1.25M. This range reflects sensitivity around the stage-progression multiplier. Key uncertainties include the actual path and timing to next funding, composition of the $175M+ LOI pipeline, and whether LOIs represent binding commitments or exploratory interest. The pre-seed stage and data scarcity limit conviction in this range; additional revenue projections or comparable term sheets would strengthen the analysis.
